## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security/Governance

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests (or targeted subset) pass
- [ ] Frontend lint/typecheck/tests pass
- [ ] Governance checks pass (`verify_environment_parity`, `verify_lockfiles`)
- [ ] Docs references verified (`scripts/verify_docs_references.py`)

## Release Checklist Impact

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (if behavior/governance changed)
- [ ] `docs/DOCS_VERSION.json` updated (if source-of-truth docs changed)
- [ ] `docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md` reviewed for impacted items

## Security/Compliance

- [ ] No hardcoded secrets introduced
- [ ] No insecure dependency source introduced
- [ ] Access-control and data-retention impact reviewed
